newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Proventus lifts Orrefors stake to 30.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Proventus lifts Orrefors stake to 30.2 pct.

text.p: Swedish investment group Proventus AB on Tuesday said it had lifted its stake in luxury glassmaker Orrefors Kosta Boda to 30.2 percent from 21.1 percent.
In a statement the unlisted Proventus said it had exercised an option to raise its holding in Orrefors Kosta Boda which is the subject of takeover bid by a three party consortium.
Proventus, Danish luxury goods maker Royal Copenhagen, and an investment arm of third major shareholder, Investor AB, have put forward a joint takeover bid for the Swedish glassmaker.
Swedish heckles were raised when Royal Copenhagen appeared poised to make a move on the prestigious, designer glassmaker.
The consortium bid, offering 155 crowns a share and open from November 18 to December 6, was a compromise to all parties involved.
Orrefors shares at 1145 GMT were 0.5 crown higher at 153 crowns.
